The turnaround was primarily driven by net gains from the sale of non-core assets, including a 50% stake in The Ritz-Carlton, Perth and properties in London and Hong Kong.
Total proceeds from completed asset sales amounted to approximately 16億元, which have been utilized for working capital and debt repayment.
Chairman and CEO Yau Tat Cheong stated the group's priority is debt reduction, aiming to lower the leverage ratio to 50% by 2027.
